entities.summary: Abbasid, a notable figure in the history of Egypt, associated with Roman, Byzantine, and Islamic Egypt (641–969). Preceded by Arab Conquest and Islamic Egypt and Roman and Coptic Egypt. Their legacy influenced Al-Azhar University and Fatimid Dynasty and Cairo.
